description.value: Kilimanjaro Snack House is an East African and South Asian snack house and catering business on Kingsway in Vancouver, serving handmade samosas, kebabs, Mogo (cassava fries), biryanis, and dishes rooted in the Kenyan-Indian coastal culinary tradition. The menu spans quick snacks to full feature dishes like Kuku Paka, Akni, and Mishkaki, reflecting a distinctive culinary heritage rarely found in BC. Cyclists passing through the Kingsway corridor will find a neighbourhood counter-service spot with a broad, flavourful menu and catering available for larger groups.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: rack at 26m; rack at 27m; rack at 60m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 65m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 70m; rack at 76m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 79m; rack at 82m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website subpage /cart confirms the phone (604-559-7050), address (789 Kingsway, Vancouver BC, V5V 3C2), and website URL, all matching OSM. The front-page menu shows extensive vegetarian options (vegetable samosas, daal bhajia, nylon bhajia, vegetable pakora, vegetable curry, spinach curry, coconut daal). The presence of a /cart page indicates online ordering, confirming takeout availability. No mentions of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'Kilimanjaro Snack House' but the website front page header reads 'KILI SNACK HOUSE + CATERING' and the /cart subpage reads 'KILIMANJARO SNACK HOUSE + CATERING' — the '+ CATERING' suffix and abbreviated front-page name are minor discrepancies worth noting if the directory listing name is updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant on Kingsway with a live website, confirmed contact details, and a full menu. Clearly publicly accessible and useful to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple vegetarian items: Vegetable Samosas, Daal Bhajia, Nylon Bhajia, Chana Bateta, Vegetable Pakora, Vegetable Curry, Karela/Bhinda Curry, Daal & Rice, Spinach Curry, Coconut Daal. No explicit vegan or GF labelling found
